bio: Johnny Claude Garrett (born August 8, 1978) is an American attorney and politician from the state of Tennessee. A member of the Republican Party, Garrett has represented the 45th district of the Tennessee House of Representatives, based in the northern suburbs of Nashville, since 2019.
offices: Member of the Tennessee House of Representatives

items.t: Co-sponsored a resolution to expel Democratic lawmakers from the Tennessee legislature for violating decorum rules (2023).
items.q: In 2023, Garrett co-sponsored a resolution to expel Democratic lawmakers from the legislature for violating decorum rules.
